If B consists of selected odd indices, maximality forces A=Z_n\N(B) and cardinality n-2 forces |N(B)|-|B|=2. Circular gap contributions min(g_i,2) imply B is a single proper interval [a,a+b-1] of length 1<=b<=n-3; each such interval yields exactly one maximal independent set. Legal slides add or remove one endpoint, giving the n-by-(n-3) cyclic strip, n(n-3) states, 2n(n-4) edges, degrees 2/4, bipartite connectivity. Lift (a,b) to (L,R)=(a,a+b-1): edges alter one coordinate by a unit while maintaining valid width; monotone interleaving yields the exact L1 geodesic in the strip, modulo diagonal n-translation. The upper distance n from closest lifts and explicit opposite offset at adjacent width show every eccentricity exactly n. Independently enumerate original graph maximal independent sets, all legal slides and BFS for n=5,7,9: vertex counts 10,28,54, all eccentricity sets {5},{7},{9}, degrees n=7 {2:14,4:14}, n=9 {2:18,4:36}. Infinite assertion rests on interval and strip proofs, not enumeration.
